recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed unless a future build reintroduces a DiagnosticReport-specific version-map page with the old generic title or misspelling.
issue_request: FHIR-13257 was a Published/Persuasive non-substantive STU3 FHIR-core DiagnosticReport issue asking that the generated DiagnosticReport version-map page title be changed from the generic Detailed Descriptions title to an R2/R3 conversions title and that the typo 'Converson' be corrected to 'Conversion'.
initial_application: Git-svn commit b33659fd70bdf970b1d547017990d5ff6523eb79, subject '#13257 fix typos', changed source/template-version-maps.html to use an R2/R3 conversions heading, corrected 'R2 : R3 Converson maps' to 'R2 : R3 Conversion maps', and updated the publisher section key for generated version-map pages.
additional_context: The version-map template later evolved from R2/R3 to R3/R4 and then R4/R5, and moved from source/template-version-maps.html to tools/templates/template-version-maps.html. DiagnosticReport remains active in source/fhir.ini. Bounded Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting community guidance for this typo-only issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current build source already has 'Resource <%title%> - R4/R5 Conversions' and 'R4 : R5 Conversion maps for <%title%>' in the active version-map template, so another source edit would be redundant.
